questions.question: An article is bought for Rs. 750 and is sold at a 25% profit. What is the cost price of the article if it is sold for Rs. 1,012.50?

questions.question: In a shop, the marked price of a sweater is Rs. 600. If it is sold at a discount of 15%, what is the new selling price?
questions.explanation: Discount amount is the percentage of the marked price that is deducted from it.

questions.question: If an item is available for Rs. 2,400 and a discount of 12% is available, how much amount will be saved?
questions.explanation: Discount amount can be calculated using the formula: Discount = Marked price * (Discount percentage / 100).

questions.question: A person bought a plot of land for Rs. 1,80,000. If he sells it at a 7% profit, then what amount will he get?

questions.question: In a shop, the cost price of a book is Rs. 240. If it is sold for Rs. 288, what is the percentage profit made?

questions.question: A pipe can fill 3/4th of a tank in 6 hours. How long will it take to fill 7/8th of the tank?
questions.explanation: Since 3/4th of the tank is filled in 6 hours, 1/4th of the tank is filled in 2 hours. To find the time for 7/8th of the tank, we need to fill 7/8 - 3/4 = 1/8 of the tank as well.

questions.question: If 6 men can finish a work in 12 days, how many men are required to finish the same work in 9 days?
questions.explanation: The number of men required is inversely proportional to the number of days. So, we can use the inverse proportion formula to find the answer.

questions.question: A man can do a piece of work in 6 days, but while working, he is assisted by his wife for half of the time. In how many days will the work be completed?
questions.explanation: The man works alone for half of the time, and assisted for the other half. So, the total work done in a day is the work done by the man alone plus the work done by the man and his wife together.

questions.question: A cistern can be filled by a pipe A in 6 hours and by pipe B in 8 hours. How long will it take to fill the cistern if both pipes are opened simultaneously?
questions.explanation: The rate of filling of the cistern by both pipes together is the sum of their individual rates of filling.

questions.question: A tap can fill 5/6th of a tank in 10 hours. In how many hours will the tap fill the remaining 1/6th part of the tank?
questions.explanation: Since 5/6th of the tank is filled in 10 hours, 1/6th of the tank is filled in 2 hours.
